summary: Validated Phase 1 (compliance/safety) + Phase 2 (camera setup coach) changes for Rehyn. Backend pytest suite (4/4 passed) confirms DELETE /api/users/account returns 401 without X-User-Id, and with a valid header returns {ok:true, deleted_at:...} and flips onboarding_complete=false. Frontend E2E via Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844) confirmed: (1) Consent gate — accept is aria-disabled=true and click does not navigate before consent-checkbox is tapped; after check + accept it routes to /onboarding. (2) session-check safety checklist — Continue is aria-disabled and does not navigate with no selection or with actor-only; enabling both (actor + safety-ack) routes to /task-intro. (3) camera-check screen renders 'Set up your camera' with camera-frame-hint and camera-check-ready testIDs; Begin on task-intro forwards to /camera-check?start_task=T1. (4) medical-disclaimer banner visible on /results, /function-summary, /rehab-plan for demo id rehyn-demo-assessment. (5) Regression: new patient → /consent → /onboarding works end-to-end. Start-over modal on /task-intro is implemented in code with a React Native <Modal> (not Alert) and all three required testIDs (task-intro-startover-modal, startover-cancel, startover-confirm); however E2E trigger requires prior completed tasks — our localStorage seed did not take effect within one page load, so this specific interaction was not fully clicked through in Playwright; code implementation is correct.
action_items: Optional: manually confirm the start-over modal E2E (tap Start over after any task completion) to close the one interaction not clicked through by Playwright — code review confirms correct <Modal> implementation with expected testIDs.

Console warnings observed (legacy, not from this iteration): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents); one 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' error on /rehab-plan. Consider cleanup later.
backend/server.py is 8817 lines; recommend future refactor into modules for maintainability (not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: consent.tsx correctly guards accept via checked flag (line 40) and disabled prop (line 81); aria-disabled reflected on web verified.
session-check.tsx continue button gated on both actor && safetyAck (line 60); verified in browser.

task-intro.tsx uses React Native <Modal transparent animationType='fade'> for start-over (lines 228-243) — NOT Alert.alert; contains testIDs task-intro-startover-modal, startover-cancel, startover-confirm.

camera-check.tsx exists at /app/frontend/app/camera-check.tsx with camera-frame-hint and camera-check-ready testIDs; task-intro Begin (line 112) routes to /camera-check which then router.replace to /assessment on Ready.
MedicalDisclaimer.tsx used on results.tsx, rehab-plan.tsx, function-summary.tsx (imports + <DisclaimerBanner /> confirmed via grep).
backend DELETE /api/users/account (server.py:8070) enforces auth header (401 without) and performs soft delete via $set deleted_at + onboarding_complete=false — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (6/7 flows fully E2E; start-over modal verified by code only)

seed_data_creation: Test users created ad hoc via POST /api/users/login with TEST_delete_* and TEST_new_* email prefixes for pytest run (soft-deleted / left flagged; no cleanup required).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AuthGate in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx redirects any un-onboarded patient user off /session-check, /task-intro, /camera-check, /results, /rehab-plan, /function-summary to /onboarding. To test those screens directly, first sign in, accept consent, then set localStorage 'onboarding_complete_v2:<uid>' = '1'. To trigger the start-over modal on /task-intro, set 'assessment_completed_tasks_v2:<uid>:initial' to JSON with at least one real task id from GET /api/assessment/tasks?package=initial (e.g. T1) BEFORE loading /task-intro. Sign-in testIDs: signin-name, signin-email, role-patient, signin-submit (note: singular 'signin-*' not 'sign-in-*').
